Paragraphs are the most basic building block of content. In DITA, they are represented by the

element and transform directly to HTML

elements.

section.title: Basic Paragraphs
section.p: This is a simple paragraph with no special formatting. It demonstrates basic text flow and wrapping.
Multiple paragraphs are separated by whitespace in the rendered output, providing clear visual distinction between thoughts.

section.title: Text Formatting
section.p: DITA supports various inline formatting options:
Bold text uses the <b> element and renders as <strong> in HTML.
Italic text uses the <i> element and renders as <em> in HTML.
Underlined text uses the <u> element for emphasis.
You can combine formatting: bold and italic text.

section.title: Special Characters and Entities
section.p: Em dashes — and en dashes – are preserved in transformation.
Copyright © and trademark ™ symbols render correctly.

section.title: Line Breaks and Whitespace
section.p: DITA normalizes whitespace, so multiple spaces are reduced to single spaces.
However, line breaks can be explicitly controlled when needed for specific formatting requirements.
